question: What are the two main forms of protection used to shield domestic industries from foreign competition in an inward looking trade strategy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tariffs and quotas**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tariffs and quotas** are the two main forms of protection used to shield domestic industries from foreign competition in an inward-looking trade strategy.
 
• **Tariffs** are **taxes imposed on imported goods**, making them more expensive and less attractive to consumers compared to domestic products.
